title: Physlib Contributions
subtitle: Signed reports on reviewing, maintenance, refactoring, foundations, formalisation and documentation of Physlib

issuer.name: Physlib Contributions
issuer.description: An open-source community project to digitalize results from physics into Lean 4. Physlib Contributions publishes signed reports on reviewing, maintenance, refactoring, foundations, formalisation and documentation of Physlib.

review.appointment: Maintainers are appointed and removed by agreement of the existing maintainers, discussed openly on the Physlib Zulip channel. Any maintainer may step down at any time.
